The **Death Tambo** is an unarmed melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A weaponized tambourine that has been modified with spikes and a grip. It jingles whenever it is thrust.

The weapon was designed by lead artist Nathan Purkeypile during an internal game jam, as part of a series of the "instruments of death." When he shared the project with an audio director, the director recorded sound effects for the weapon on his own tambourine, and thus the weapon made its way into the final game. [Dev 1]
